talk: Hello Maren. Is the lamp lit yet?
Tell me about the wreck of the Asta.
Can we climb up to the gallery?
Could you help me plan my week? I have three deadlines.
Make me a list: groceries for four days.
Thanks. Back to the lighthouse: is a storm coming?
I hold the lantern while you check the lens.
What did your father teach you about the light?
Please summarise what we did today in two lines.
Good night, Maren. I'll come back tomorrow.
